product.description: Monoprice™SlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Ultra High Speed Active HDMI® CableNext gen Fiber Optic technology for today's gaming consolesThe Monoprice™ SlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Ultra High Speed Active HDMI® Cable enables full 8K performance over distances up to 65 feet. These cables are certified by an HDMI authorized testing center and support up to 8K@60Hz or 4K@120Hz resolutions, with up to 48Gbps bandwidth and all other features found in the HDMI 2.1 specification. These cables feature next gen fiber optic technology, which makes it the perfect choice for the latest gaming consoles, including the Sony® PlayStation® 5, PlayStation 5 Digital Edition, Microsoft® Xbox Series X™, and Xbox Series S™.Active Optical Cable (AOC) improves signal performance over longer lengthsSupports 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz resolutionsDynamic HDR supportCertified by an HDMI authorized testing centerUp to 48Gbps bandwidthBest option for PlayStation® 5, Xbox Series X™, Xbox Series S™ and other game consoles  CERTIFIED SLIMRUN AV 8KThis Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable supports up to 48Gbps bandwidth to handle all features found in the HDMI® 2.1 specification. It features very low EMI emission, is backwards compatible with earlier versions of the HDMI specification, and can be used with all existing HDMI devices. SMOOTHEST AND FASTEST ACTION DETAILSMonoprice™ SlimRun™ AV 8K Certified cables support uncompressed resolutions and refresh rates up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz for immersive viewing and smooth, fast action detail. Additionally, they can support resolutions up to 10K@120Hz at Compression (DSC) 1.2a. 8K RESOLUTION AT LENGTHS NEVER POSSIBLE BEFORESlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Cables use an active chipset and optical fiber to support uncompressed video at resolutions up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz, with cable lengths never possible before with traditional copper cables.Available Lengths: 24, 32, 49, 65 feet ENHANCED FEATURES FOR THE BEST GAMING EXPERIENCEVariable Refresh Rate (VRR) reduces or eliminates lag, stutter, and frame tearing for more fluid and detailed gameplay.Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) allows the ideal latency setting to be automatically set for smooth, lag‑free and uninterrupted viewing and interactivity.Quick Frame Transport (QFT) reduces latency for smoother no‑lag gaming and real‑time interactive virtual reality. DYNAMIC HDR SUPPORTDynamic HDR support ensures every moment of a video is displayed at its ideal values for depth, detail, brightness, contrast, and wider color gamuts on a scene‑by‑scene or even a frame‑by‑frame basis. With support for up to 12‑bits per channel color depth, this cable increases the color spaces and brightness with dynamic color mapping. ARC, EARC, DOLBY ATMOS, AND DTS:X SUPPORTSlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Cables are fully compatible with the HDMI® ARC/eARC (Audio Return Channel/Enhanced Audio Return Channel) feature. It also supports immersive, multichannel audio streams, including the Dolby Atmos® and DTS:X® advanced 5.1/7.1 channel surround sound modes. .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
